Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
Then Jacob, lifting up his eyes, saw Esau coming with his four hundred men. So he made a division of the children between Leah and Rachel and the two women-servants.
雅各舉目觀看，見以掃來了，後頭跟著四百人，他就把孩子們分開交給利亞、拉結，和兩個使女，
He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after them, and Rachel and Joseph at the back.
並且叫兩個使女和她們的孩子在前頭，利亞和她的孩子在後頭，拉結和約瑟在儘後頭。
But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
And he himself, going before them, went down on his face to the earth seven times till he came near his brother.
他自己在他們前頭過去，一連七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
Then Esau came running up to him, and folding him in his arms, gave him a kiss: and the two of them were overcome with weeping.
以掃跑來迎接他，將他抱住，又摟著他的頸項，與他親嘴，兩個人就哭了。
When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
Then Esau, lifting up his eyes, saw the women and the children, and said, Who are these with you? And he said, The children whom God in his mercy has given to your servant.
以掃舉目看見婦人孩子，就說：「這些和你同行的是誰呢？」雅各說：「這些孩子是神施恩給你的僕人的。」
Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
Then the servants and their children came near, and went down on their faces.
於是兩個使女和她們的孩子前來下拜；
Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.
And Leah came near with her children, and then Joseph and Rachel, and they did the same.
利亞和她的孩子也前來下拜；隨後約瑟和拉結也前來下拜。
“What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau. “To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
And he said, What were all those herds which I saw on the way? And Jacob said, They were an offering so that I might have grace in my lord's eyes.
以掃說：「我所遇見的這些群畜是甚麼意思呢？」雅各說：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」
“I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
But Esau said, I have enough; keep what is yours, my brother, for yourself.
以掃說：「兄弟啊，我的已經夠了，你的仍歸你吧！」

But Jacob insisted, “No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.
And Jacob said, Not so; but if I have grace in your eyes, take them as a sign of my love, for I have seen your face as one may see the face of God, and you have been pleased with me.
雅各說：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你從我手裡收下這禮物；因為我見了你的面，如同見了神的面，並且你容納了我。
Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.
Take my offering then, with my blessing; for God has been very good to me and I have enough: so at his strong request, he took it.
求你收下我帶來給你的禮物；因為神恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
And he said, Let us go on our journey together, and I will go in front.
以掃說：「我們可以起身前往，我在你前頭走。」
But Jacob replied, “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
But Jacob said, My lord may see that the children are only small, and there are young ones in my flocks and herds: one day's over-driving will be the destruction of all the flock.
雅各對他說：「我主知道孩子們年幼嬌嫩，牛羊也正在乳養的時候，若是催趕一天，群畜都必死了。
Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
Do you, my lord, go on before your servant; I will come on slowly, at the rate at which the cattle and the children are able to go, till I come to my lord at Seir.
求我主在僕人前頭走，我要量著在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那裡。」
“Let me leave some of my people with you,” Esau said. But Jacob replied, “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
And Esau said, Then keep some of my men with you. And he said, What need is there for that, if my lord is pleased with me?
以掃說：「容我把跟隨我的人留幾個在你這裡。」雅各說：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」
So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir,
So Esau, turning back that day, went on his way to Seir.
於是，以掃當日起行，回往西珥去了。
but Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called Succoth.
And Jacob went on to Succoth, where he made a house for himself and put up tents for his cattle: for this reason the place was named Succoth.
雅各就往疏割去，在那裡為自己蓋造房屋，又為牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割（就是棚的意思）。
After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
So Jacob came safely from Paddan-aram to the town of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and put up his tents near the town.
雅各從巴旦‧亞蘭回來的時候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示劍城，在城東支搭帳棚，
And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
And for a hundred bits of money he got from the children of Hamor, the builder of Shechem, the field in which he had put up his tents.
就用一百塊銀子向示劍的父親、哈抹的子孫買了支帳棚的那塊地，
There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
And there he put up an altar, naming it El, the God of Israel.
在那裡築了一座壇，起名叫伊利‧伊羅伊‧以色列（就是神、以色列神的意思）。
